title: Private deployment orchestrator connection loss during 2025-03 upgrade — post-incident review & remediation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: On 2025-03-04 at 03:18 UTC a subset (~12%) of Private/VPC deployments experienced a partial outage: internal orchestrator agents lost stable gRPC connections to the control-layer resulting in API failures and short-lived leader elections. Impact included API timeouts for customer workloads, failing health checks, and automatic rollback of several in-flight job rollouts. Total customer-visible disruption lasted ~18 minutes for affected clusters; no data loss was observed. The issue was triggered during the staged rollout of orchestrator agent v2.7.0 which included a networking helper script change and an overlay network MTU adjustment that exposed a race between iptables regeneration and the agent's connection warmup. This ticket captures the incident timeline, root cause analysis, immediate mitigations, and tracked action items.
timeline: 2025-03-04T03:10Z - Canary rollout of orchestrator-agent v2.7.0 started in two private regions.
2025-03-04T03:18Z - First alerts: increased gRPC error rates and control-layer leadership changes on 6 clusters.
2025-03-04T03:25Z - Pager duty triggered; on-call ran connectivity checks and observed intra-node TCP resets on orchestrator port 7001.
2025-03-04T03:30Z - Rollback of v2.7.0 initiated for all canaries; mitigation revealed iptables rules had DROP entries blocking overlay peer ports on recently-upgraded nodes.
2025-03-04T03:34Z - Ops applied emergency iptables fix and cleared conntrack entries on affected nodes; gRPC streams recovered gradually.
2025-03-04T03:48Z - Metrics stabilized; leader elections settled. Post-incident monitoring continued for two hours.
2025-03-06 - Engineering root cause review completed and action items assigned.
root_cause: A two-part sequence: (1) packaging change in the v2.7.0 rollout introduced a new iptables regeneration helper that, on the initial post-upgrade execution, inserted a DROP rule into a custom chain before the rules that allow overlay peer traffic; and (2) an MTU adjustment to the overlay network was performed in the same upgrade window which created intermittent PMTU blackholes for long gRPC packets. The combination caused intra-cluster gRPC connections to stall; the orchestrator interpreted stalls as node failure, triggering leader election thrashing. A race condition meant the helper ran before the host-level persistence step completed, so the transient DROP remained until manual cleanup removed the rule.
mitigations: Immediate rollback of orchestrator-agent v2.7.0 in all canaries (completed).
Emergency removal of offending iptables DROP rules and conntrack flush on affected nodes (completed).
Temporary hold on all network-affecting packaging changes until additional preflight checks are in place (enforced).
action_items: ENG-13159: Add an integration upgrade test that simulates MTU mismatch and validates gRPC connectivity for orchestrator agents - owner: Liang Chen - due: 2025-03-18
ENG-13160: Patch packaging helper to ensure iptables edits are additive and order-preserving; include dry-run validation step in package CI - owner: Marco Ruiz - due: 2025-03-14
ENG-13161: Add preflight connectivity probe to rollback pipeline: fail upgrade if intra-node gRPC latency >200ms during warmup - owner: Sofia Gomez - due: 2025-03-21
ENG-13162: Create an automated remediation playbook to detect and remove transient DROP rules and flush conntrack entries during upgrades - owner: Ops Team - due: 2025-03-12
ENG-13163: Add dashboards and alerts for intra-node gRPC error-rate and control-layer leader-change rate (SLO: <1 leader change per 30m) - owner: Delaney Ortiz - due: 2025-03-11
ENG-13164: Run a full rollout rehearsal (canary -> staged) for network and agent upgrades in a dedicated test VPC with PMTU variation injected - owner: QA Infra - due: 2025-03-25
ENG-13165: Update runbook and postmortem templates to call out iptables and conntrack checks explicitly for private/VPC upgrades - owner: Aisha Patel - due: 2025-03-10
notes: No customer data integrity issues detected; service resumed after rollback + iptables fix.
Related PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821 (packaging helper change - reverted)
